Ampa is a pioneering neurotechnology startup developing brain stimulation technology to help eradicate depression . We will improve millions of lives by making this transformative treatment universally accessible. Joining us means you’ll be part of a rapidly growing startup with significant equity opportunities and a major impact on our future.

Role Overview: Ampa is hiring our first dedicated full cycle sales representative to sell our TMS system to psychiatrists, clinic owners, and mental health practices across the US.

Key Responsibilities: Own the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, demo, negotiate, close, and deposit collection Generate your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals, and creative channel development Deliver compelling product demos to psychiatrists and clinic owners, both virtual and in person Build and maintain long-term relationships with clinical customers to facilitate upsells Partner closely with our founding executive team on strategy, positioning, and high-value deals Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasting in our CRM Share market and customer feedback with product and marketing to sharpen our go-to-market What We’re Looking For: 5+ years of full cycle sales experience, with a track record of hunting and closing your own deals Experience selling high-ticket capital equipment or subscription to physician-owned clinics, ideally in medical devices, medtech, or adjacent markets Verifiable quota attainment.

You should be able to walk us through the specific deals that got you to your number Proven ability to break into new accounts and build channels from scratch, without relying on the infrastructure of a large company Consultative, substance-first selling style.

Our buyers are psychiatrists who respond to clinical credibility, ROI clarity, and intelligence Comfort with long sales cycles and cash-pay ROI conversations with practice owners Startup mindset: resourceful, persistent, and energized by ambiguity Why Join Ampa? Impact: Lead the growth of transformative mental health technologies.

## About Outsite
Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.
## About Outsite for Teams
Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.
This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound
· Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder
· Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base
· Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging
· Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages
· Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities
### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management
· Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture
· Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close
· Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged
· Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets
### 3. Collaboration & Handoff
· Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound
· Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals
· Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time
### 4. Reporting
· Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers
· Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

· 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)
· Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders
· Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads
· Able to work autonomously and independently
· Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive
· Comfortable working European timezone hours
· Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job
· Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to
· Comfortable using AI in workflow

· Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams
· Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot
· Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space
· Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product
## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)
· A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)
· A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM
· First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed
· Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing
· Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

· Remote, travel encouraged
· Credits for Outsite locations
· Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

If you've done outbound for a while, you know what most SDR roles actually look like: a number on a board, a script to follow, and meetings that get booked whether they're ready or not. We built this role differently.
Our SDRs spend 15 to 30 minutes on a qualifying call. Not to pitch, but to actually understand what's broken in a prospect's business and whether it's worth an AE's time. We call it a pain chain: symptom, root cause, business cost. And: No chain, no meeting; the AE will send it back for further qualification. It keeps the quality honest and it means the work you do actually matters downstream. If you're ready to trade volume for something with more substance, it's worth a conversation.
🎯 What you’ll own
Your accounts are mid-market and enterprise (150-5,000 employees). You run the full qualification process before anything reaches an AE, which in practice looks like this:
Qualification calls that go long enough to build a real case, not just confirm that someone picked up
Re-engagement on accounts that have been approached before, with a genuine plan for how to get in differently
Follow-up calls with yourself when a first conversation doesn't go deep enough, rather than booking something that isn't ready
Finding your own contacts when the data isn't clean, because it often isn't
Keeping HubSpot honest so your pipeline reflects reality
Working closely enough with your AE that what you hand off actually lands

You've done B2B outbound before and you have a real opinion on what makes a qualification call worth something. That's the baseline.
1-2 years of outbound sales or SDR experience in B2B
You've worked accounts with no clean data, navigated gatekeepers, and made multi-touch sequences actually work
You think about pipeline quality, not just volume, and you can explain the difference to someone who disagrees
Fluent German, working English
You manage your own day well and take feedback seriously when it comes
🤩 What's different here
The qualification bar here is genuinely high. A meeting without a clear pain chain doesn't move forward, and you're expected to know that before it reaches the AE. There's no hiding behind dial counts or activity metrics when the pipeline tells a different story.
The accounts you'll work aren't easy. No clean contact data, gatekeepers who've heard every opener, prospects who need a few different approaches before they pick up. The job isn't to call more. It's to find the angle that works, and to keep looking until you do.
When it clicks, you feel it. Your pipeline moves, your meetings convert, and the AE comes back wanting more. People here have moved to AE in around 24 months. That track is real, and it starts with the quality of what you build in this role.
🚀 Why doinstruct
You'll get coaching from Jiri (one of Germany's top sales trainers) alongside day-to-day feedback from an SDR lead who's genuinely among the best in the country
The SDR team has real influence on how we approach markets. You're not just running someone else's sequences
We're honest about what's working and what isn't, in both directions
400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which makes the conversation easier

Business Development Representative
Turn strong, growing inbound demand into qualified pipeline — supported by targeted ABX outbound and the industry’s biggest events
There are a lot of security companies out there, but no one is doing what Nucleus is doing: giving security teams the ability to run the most effective vulnerability and exposure management program possible. Some of the largest enterprises and government agencies in the world run on our platform, and we’re growing fast. Top-tier venture funding, an amazing team who will fight beside you to accomplish the impossible, great benefits, and fully remote.
Here’s the good news about this seat: our inbound demand is strong and growing. Your primary job is to work it well — respond fast, qualify sharply, and turn real interest into meetings your AE counterparts are glad to take. You’ll back that up with targeted outbound into named accounts as part of our account-based (ABX) program, and you’ll represent Nucleus face to face at the industry’s biggest security events a few times a year.
Why this role exists
This is a new seat created by growth — driven in large part by inbound volume we want to convert better and faster. Your individual output is visible and it matters. You’ll also be joining a leader whose real strength is developing top-performing BDRs: structured onboarding, weekly coaching and mock calls, and a documented track record of promoting reps into account executive, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.

Own inbound — this is the priority. Be the first, fast, credible response to the people raising their hands: demo requests, content and webinar leads, event follow-up, and trial interest. Qualify with real discovery — need, timing, environment, decision process — and convert genuine interest into meetings that stick. Speed and judgment both matter: our buyers are busy, and the first good conversation usually wins.
Support the ABX program with targeted outbound. Outbound here is deliberate, not a numbers game. You’ll work a defined set of high-value named accounts alongside Marketing and your AEs — using intent and account signals to time your outreach — so outbound reinforces the accounts we’ve collectively decided matter most.
Personalize everything, and use AI to do it well. Our buyers are technical and busy. You’ll write outreach and follow-up that sounds like a person who understands their world — and you’ll use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) every day to research faster and sharpen your messaging.
Run a clean process. Manage inbound routing, accounts, and follow-up in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and Gong — and partner closely with your AEs and Marketing to act on campaign signals fast.
Represent Nucleus at our biggest events. A few times a year, our BDRs are the front line at RSAC, Black Hat, the Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit, and other key events — proactively engaging people in and around our booth, qualifying on the spot, and booking high-quality meetings. Expect roughly 3–4 events a year, plus our annual company and sales kickoff.
Your first 90 days
We’ve run this playbook before, and we don’t leave ramp to chance:
First 30 days
By 60 days
By 90 days
Structured onboarding and product training. Learn our market, ICP, and the vulnerability and exposure management problems our buyers face. Shadow calls, run mock calls, and start handling live inbound with close coaching.
Owning inbound response and qualification for your patch, with outbound sequences live into your named ABX accounts. Weekly 1:1s and email-writing sessions to sharpen your craft.
Fully ramped and holding your own number — converting inbound into qualified meetings, supporting ABX outbound, and confident enough in the material to represent Nucleus in front of a security buyer.

2–4+ years in sales or business development — BDR/SDR, inside sales, or another customer-facing role. Experience handling real inbound volume with a high qualification bar is especially relevant.
Sharp qualification instincts. You can tell a genuine opportunity from a tire-kicker quickly, and you protect your AEs’ calendars without dropping real interest on the floor.
Outbound capability too. You can build and run a thoughtful, targeted sequence into a named account when it matters — not just work a queue.
Cybersecurity or technical SaaS experience preferred. Holding a credible conversation with a security buyer is a meaningful advantage.
Strong communication. Concise and credible in writing and on the phone with senior technical people.
Comfortable in person. You genuinely enjoy meeting people face to face and can open a conversation with a stranger on a busy expo floor.
AI-fluent. Using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude in your daily workflow is a requirement, not a bonus.
Tech-savvy. Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Slack, Teams, and Zoom.
Curious, resilient, and coachable. You want to be coached — this is a team where you’ll get real feedback and be expected to use it.
Nice to have: selling into U.S. Federal, Defense, or State & Local government; an established cybersecurity network; a bachelor’s or associate degree.
If you have less experience than the range above but can show real results and genuine curiosity about security, we’d still like to hear from you. We hire for trajectory and coachability, not just years on a resume.
Why you should be excited
The mission. We automate enterprise vulnerability and exposure management so security teams can prioritize and mitigate risk, at scale — working toward a world where remediation outpaces exploitation.
Warm demand to work with. You’re not starting from zero. Inbound interest is real and growing, and your job is to make the most of it.
The career path. A launchpad, run by a leader who builds and promotes top performers into AE, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.
Nucleus believes “work is people”, and when our people succeed, our company succeeds.

Quartzy is hiring a Senior Territory Manager to own gross profit dollar growth across a defined New York City/Northern New Jersey book of business. You will acquire new SaaS customers, expand revenue within our existing accounts in the region, and drive e-commerce adoption across every logo in your territory. This is a full-cycle role: hunt net-new logos, deepen relationships in existing accounts, and influence scientists and procurement teams to buy more through Quartzy.
This role is based in Northern New Jersey or the NYC area and requires regular in-person meetings across biotech hubs across the territory, including Philadelphia.

You’re a proactive, field-oriented commercial rep who understands how scientists buy supplies and how labs operate day to day. You can prospect into new labs, run structured sales cycles, and then expand those accounts post-close. You are credible with scientists, lab managers, procurement, and finance teams, and you enjoy being inside labs to understand real workflows and buying patterns. You are excited to learn SaaS sales and want to broaden your skill set.
If you want material impact on a profitable, scaling business, this is the role.
Why Quartzy
At Quartzy, we believe science moves faster when labs spend less time on logistics and more time on discovery. Our platform streamlines how labs order, track, and manage supplies so researchers can focus on scientific breakthroughs that change the world.
Quartzy is the world’s #1 lab management platform, trusted by hundreds of thousands of scientists worldwide. By combining SaaS and eCommerce in a unique business model loved by customers, we help researchers spend less time on logistics and more time on discovery.

From cancer research and climate change to winemaking and vegan cheese, our impact is broad and meaningful. You’ll have the flexibility of remote work, the security of a profitable business, and the purpose of contributing to discoveries that matter. At Quartzy, your work has impact—on your life, your career, and on science worldwide.

1. New Logo Acquisition (Hunter)
· Identify, prospect, and close new SaaS customers across biotech hubs in your territory.
· Own the full SaaS cycle: discovery, demo, technical validation, ROI, negotiation, and close. Build pipeline through cold outreach, on-site visits, networking, cluster events, and referrals.
· Land new SaaS accounts that become part of your territory for continued growth.
2. Expansion of Existing Accounts (Farmer)
· Maintain and grow GP$ across existing customers in your territory.
· Meet in-person with scientists and procurement teams to increase e-commerce adoption.
· Use Salesforce/Looker data to spot product-category gaps, missed savings, or workflow friction.
· Introduce new product categories and promotions to expand Quartzy’s share of wallet.
3. Cross-functional Collaboration
· Partner with Marketing on campaigns that support both SaaS and e-commerce.
· Coordinate with Supply, Software, Pricing, Customer Success, and Operations to relay field insights and strengthen company across the board.

5+ years of life science sales experience, specifically selling laboratory supplies for a distributor or manufacturer.
Degree from a top 50 university.
Strong familiarity with lab products, consumables, and procurement workflows in biotech.
Comfortable talking to scientists and driving conversations in person.
Demonstrated hustle. You have consistently hit goals in prior roles, even if they were not traditional sales roles.
Experience negotiating with Procurement professionals at BioPharma companies.
Existing relationships and a network of contacts in SMB biotech to help accelerate growth.
Based in Northern New Jersey or NYC or willing to relocate there. Willing to visit customers and prospects frequently.
Willing to travel to Philadelphia about 33% of the time and Harrisburg about twice a year.

Profitable & Growing - A stable, scaling business with clear long-term opportunity.

About Revelo
Revelo provides top quality tech talent from Latin American countries to US and Canadian companies hiring remotely.
We are a tech first company that uses our technology to source, match and allocate remote digital workers faster, cheaper and more accurately than competitors. We are in the middle of the biggest shift to remote work that the world has ever seen - come be a part of it!
With large amounts of capital being injected into Brazil and Latin America over the previous 15 years from both national and international venture capital and capital equity, there has been a significant increase in the education of professionals and adolescents with skills in all aspects of technology (software development, data science, product development, product management, crypto, and so forth).

This rapid growth of maturing companies has made Latin America a key producer of high caliber tech talent. The pandemic opened the eyes of North American companies to the opportunity of accessing that talent for a new pool of candidates beyond the saturated and more competitive markets they’re used to recruiting in.
Born in 2015 out of São Paulo, over the course of 8 years we’ve gained vast expertise in sourcing, recruiting and placing tech talent throughout Latin America. We’re now able to share that knowledge and help companies connect to the right talent to build their technology.

The SDR, Strategic Accounts is responsible for generating new business opportunities across both prospective and existing customer accounts. The role focuses on strategic account development, identifying high-value opportunities within complex organizations and creating meaningful engagement with the right stakeholders.
For prospective accounts , the SDR owns outbound prospecting efforts to identify and create new opportunities within high-priority strategic accounts. This includes researching accounts, identifying key stakeholders and buying groups, leveraging intent and account signals, and developing personalized outreach that creates meaningful sales conversations.
For customer accounts , the focus shifts toward expansion . The SDR partners closely with Account Directors and other customer-facing teams to identify whitespace, new teams or business units, additional use cases, and other signals that may indicate an opportunity for growth. · participez activement à la vie de l'équipe et à l'amélioration continue de notre programme
### Votre profil: ###
Nous cherchons un-e professionnel-le expérimenté-e de l'accompagnement et du monde du travail, capable de créer une relation de confiance tout en maintenant un cadre clair. Vous disposez idéalement :

### Notre offre: ###

Membre du groupe Sigmalis, actif depuis 2007 dans le conseil et l-ingénierie en informatique, Sigmalis Talent Services accompagne les entreprises dans l-identification et l-attraction d'experts IT et de cadres, en proposant une offre complète en recrutement: placement fixe, délégation en régie, mission temporaire et executive search.
Notre expertise en recrutement depuis plus de 20 ans en Suisse Romande, associée à une compréhension approfondie des métiers technologiques et des enjeux RH, nous permet de vous proposer des opportunités pertinentes dans des environnements professionnels réellement adaptés à vos attentes. Notre priorité est d-assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d-un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe.
### Description du poste ###
Dans le cadre d-une mission auprès de l-un de nos clients, nous recherchons un(e) **Consultant(e) fonctionnel(le) et technique Salesforce** disposant d-une expertise confirmée sur **Salesforce Marketing Cloud et Sales Cloud**.
**Le taux d'activité est de 50%.**
Vous interviendrez dans un environnement où Salesforce occupe une place centrale dans la gestion de la relation client, avec pour objectif d-optimiser les processus, d-améliorer la personnalisation des interactions et de renforcer l-automatisation des campagnes marketing.
## Vos missions ##
Vous intervenez à la fois sur les dimensions **fonctionnelles, techniques et organisationnelles** des plateformes Salesforce.
### Salesforce Marketing Cloud ###

* mettre en place et optimiser la segmentation des audiences,
* concevoir et automatiser les campagnes marketing : journeys, triggers, requêtes SQL,
* créer et adapter des templates de newsletters,
* développer des modèles de reporting permettant de mesurer la performance des campagnes,
* assurer les intégrations avec le CRM et les autres systèmes internes.
### Salesforce Sales Cloud ###

* l-implémentation et l-optimisation de workflows automatisés,
* la création et la configuration de champs techniques et d-objets,
* la personnalisation des tableaux de bord et du reporting,
* l-optimisation du pipeline commercial,
* l-intégration de Sales Cloud avec des systèmes externes, notamment via API.
## Support et accompagnement des utilisateurs ##
Vous assurez également un rôle de référent fonctionnel et technique auprès des équipes :
* support sur Marketing Cloud et Sales Cloud,
* accompagnement dans l-utilisation quotidienne des segments, workflows, dashboards et campagnes,
* formation des équipes internes afin de renforcer progressivement leur autonomie.
## Amélioration continue et gouvernance ##
Vous participez activement à l-optimisation et à la gouvernance des plateformes Salesforce :
* audit régulier des environnements Marketing Cloud et Sales Cloud,
* analyse et nettoyage des segments, doublons et workflows devenus obsolètes,
* définition et mise à jour des bonnes pratiques d-administration,
* mise en place de conventions de nommage, règles d-archivage et standards documentaires,
* proposition d-améliorations fonctionnelles, techniques et organisationnelles,
* recueil et clarification des besoins métiers,
* animation d-ateliers avec les équipes internes,
* rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles,
* définition et suivi de la gouvernance Salesforce,
* prise en compte des exigences de conformité **GDPR et LIPAD**.
## Gestion des évolutions et des environnements ##
Dans le cadre des différents projets Salesforce, vous assurez également :
* le suivi des évolutions et nouvelles implémentations,
* la gestion du cycle de vie des environnements, notamment de la sandbox vers la production,
* la mise en place et la supervision des processus de sauvegarde et de restauration ;
* la documentation systématique des changements,
* le suivi et le reporting de l-avancement des travaux.
### Profil recherché ###
Vous êtes titulaire d-un **Bachelor dans le domaine informatique ou d-une formation équivalente**.
Vous disposez d-une expertise confirmée sur **Salesforce Marketing Cloud**, notamment sur :
* Automation Studio
* Journey Builder
* Email Studio
* SQL Query
* intégrations API.
Vous possédez également une solide expérience de **Salesforce Sales Cloud**, incluant notamment :
* Process Builder / Flows
* champs personnalisés
* objets Salesforce
* dashboards
* reporting.
Une expérience dans l-intégration de Salesforce avec des sites web, CRM et autres systèmes via API est attendue. Vous maîtrisez également les principes de gouvernance Salesforce, l-analyse de données marketing et les bonnes pratiques en matière de sécurité et de conformité GDPR/LIPAD.
## Compétences fonctionnelles ##
Une bonne compréhension des environnements métiers suivants est recherchée :
* marketing et web-marketing
* e-commerce
* commerce lié au transport de voyageurs
* retail et ventes en boutique.

**Governance**\* Manage the co-ordination of PSI constitutional bodies across departments and regions
\* Monitor and advise on governance matters including composition of governance bodies, and ensure compliance with governance requirements as set out in the constitution
\* Oversee reporting and act as a senior advisor for the preparation of policies for decision making, and records of meeting
**Affiliate relations**\* Develop and implement strategy to ensure excellent communication and engagement with affiliates
\* Co-ordinate political aspects of affiliate relations
\* Co-ordinate affiliate and external requests
**Monitoring and planning**
\* Continuously scan for internal and external threats and opportunities and identify, advise and manage risk
\* Ensure coherence and monitor implementation of governance, work programs and strategy across HO departments and regions
\* Support the GS and Senior Management Team in whole of organisation planning
**Political and Strategic Support**
\* Develop and implement ad hoc strategies in areas of GS or SMT political or organisational priority
\* Manage responsibilities allocated to the GS office such as political oversight of Aid fund and the management representation budget line
\* Assist the GS with political duties such as speeches, co-ordination of briefings, preparations for meetings and political aspects of travel
\* Collate, oversee or draft memos, letters, policy, reporting and strategic documents for GS
\* Provide strategic political and organisation advice to the GS
\* Liaise with staff, affiliates and external partners**Other duties as assigned by General Secretary**
**Supervision:** The position will report to the General Secretary**.**
**Staff management:** NIL
**Internal relationships:** The position will work in close collaboration with the heads of HO departments, regional secretaries, communications team, Personal Assistant to the GS and staff working on membership, governance and affiliate relations.
## The Successful Applicant ##
**Education, knowledge and experience**\* A degree in social sciences, law, public policy, labour, or equivalent experience.
\* At least 5 years' experience in the trade union movement, political party, government, or equivalent at the national, regional or global level.
\* At least 2 years' experience in a governance function, or similar experience, in a membership-based organisation, political party, student organisation or government
\* Experience supporting leaders in a political, membership-based or government organisation
\* Strong understanding of governance functions in a membership-based organisation
\* Strong understanding of the support needs of a senior leader in a government, trade union or political party.
\* Broad knowledge of trade unions across the globe, especially public service trade unions
**Skills and attributes**\* High level political acumen, ability to maintain multiple and complex political relationships and influence
\* High level problem-solving skills to drive creative solutions in political and ambiguous environments
\* Ability to identify risks and opportunities, adapt to diverse situations and flexibly and rapidly respond
\* Ability to write under pressure, quickly source, synthesise and collate information for succinct briefs in a wide range of areas, often outside your area of expertise
\* Strong time management and task coordination skills in an environment without direct supervision and with ambiguity
\* Ability to balance urgent tasks with long term strategic priorities
\* Ability to establish and monitor organisational plans, budgets and work programs and advise on risks, opportunities and corrective actions
\* Strong team player, able to communicate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds
\* Ability to act decisively on behalf of a principal without overstepping authority
\* Ability to draft timely, accurate reports for internal and external accountability
\* Strong attention to detail
\* Familiarity with the concepts and operations of membership systems or CRM tools
\* Project management skills
\* Policy development expertise an advantage
\* Demonstrated commitment to gender equality
\* Ability to travel
**Languages**\* Ability to write and speak fluently in English is essential.
\* Spanish is highly desirable. Other PSI languages such as French, German or Japanese are an advantage.

High-quality fresh chocolate - that's what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business now employs over 2500 people from more than 80 countries across the group, and the trend is rising. The company's headquarters are located in the canton of Glarus. Here, against a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates and are constantly developing new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The Retail business unit comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate in ever new ways. Want to be part of it too? Come and join us.
##### What you can expect #####
* You provide customer-oriented advice and sell our diverse product range, for example by supporting customers in selecting gifts
* You actively engage with our customers, identify their needs and offer suitable solutions
* You handle cash register operations and ensure precise and accurate cash reconciliation
* You present our exquisite confectionery and chocolate range in an appealing and inviting way
* You also carry out production-related tasks as well as replenishing and maintaining the sales areas
* You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care
* You consistently ensure compliance with our hygiene and freshness concept
* You work closely with your team and contribute to a positive working environment
##### What we expect from you #####
* You have experience in retail and are passionate about sales as well as direct customer contact
* You quickly recognise customer needs and provide friendly, personalised and convincing advice
* You have very good German and English skills; knowledge of French and other languages is an advantage
* You work responsibly, reliably and with a strong focus on quality, while consistently complying with hygiene and cleanliness standards
* You are a team player, enjoy taking on responsibility and want to further develop your skills in sales and customer service
* You are flexible and available to work on weekends and public holidays
* An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues
